subject: Use of distance sampling in fisheries

messages.subject: Use of distance sampling in fisheries
parts:
Hi All,

I've received a query from Alf Ring Kleiven (alf.ring....@imr.no),
a PhD student in Norway, looking to contact anyone who's used distance
sampling methods on fishing vessels and gear. He used strip transects
to estimate total effort in the lobster fishery, apparently. So, if you
know anything, please contact him directly. Thanks,

- Len Thomas

--
